# Record observed popup placement as a transaction participant

## Context

D#18224 resolved window placement as a semantic participant expressed relative to the main frame. `manager.Window` already reports live outer rectangles and the dock drag coordinator already has a candidate-scoped 250ms quiescence endpoint. The missing behavior is free native movement outside a drag candidate.

## The Problem

Persisting absolute screen coordinates breaks when monitor topology changes. Recording requested `moveTo` coordinates lies when the browser refuses or clamps them. Treating every relative-offset delta as a popup transaction is also wrong: moving the main frame changes all popup offsets even though no popup moved.

## The Architectural Reality

`manager.Window` stays geometry-only. A Group-bound placement participant observes which `windowId` changed. Popup movement appends one quiesced before/after `{dx,dy}` effect-first transaction; main movement re-bases every durable hint and snapshot without advancing history. Undo updates the hint, requests movement, then records the observed effect separately.

## Producer boundary

This participant observes placement for semantic workspace documents already registered in the Group. A documentless window reservation has no durable placement-hint key. #18314 owns ordinary tear-out admission as a full Workspace through the Group claim, including the first semantic document and shared-history write; #18316 proves the composed production save/reload/undo journey. This is the existing D#18224 full-Workspace contract, not permission to preserve bare vessels as the delivered product or to introduce a second document owner. All seven placement acceptance criteria below remain required.

## The Fix

Lift the existing quiescence mechanism beyond candidate scope, bind it to Group workspace slots, derive offsets from observed main/popup rows, and implement popup-versus-main ingestion. Restore clamps against current screens or uses semantic `fallbackTarget`; the main slot persists no rectangle. Geometry caused by an admitted native effect is correlated to that effect's transaction and window generation; it completes an observed receipt rather than entering again as a free user move.

| quiescence | existing 250ms candidate clock | one start/end record for a free move | no stable end means no invented row | JSDoc | burst coalescing control |

## Decision Record impact

Amends/implements ADR 0029's former no-geometry rule with relative semantic hints only.

## Decision Record

Required prerequisite: the #18303 hard-cut ADR leaf.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping

Owns OQ1 and the native-effect half of criterion 8.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A popup free move produces one quiesced before/after relative-offset transaction from observed rows.
- [ ] A burst of movement reports coalesces through the existing bounded clock; the mechanism is lifted, not duplicated.
- [ ] Moving only the main window with N popups re-bases N hints and publishes one current snapshot without appending history or moving a popup.
- [ ] Undo/redo requests popup placement from the updated hint and stores the observed terminal effect separately. Exercise undo → native move → geometry reports → quiescence: the reports append no new transaction, leave the undo cursor and redo tail intact, and redo remains usable. A subsequent independent user move still appends once; a blanket suppression that loses that move fails the control.
- [ ] Refused/clamped native movement never records requested coordinates as truth. A late receipt for a retired window generation cannot move or update its successor.
- [ ] The durable schema contains no absolute rect, monitor id, screen coordinate, or `windowId`; the main slot has no rect.
- [ ] Missing screen topology clamps or uses `fallbackTarget` while keeping semantic composition restorable.

## Out of Scope

Cross-Group movement, drag target isolation, transaction-history storage, or popup creation permission.

## Avoided Traps

No absolute geometry; no manager.Window history logic; no candidate-only detector; no one-row-per-frame log; no popup row for a main-only move.

## Related

Part of #18303. Blocked by Group identity, immutable history, and atomic commit.

Causality precedent: [`DragCoordinator#onWindowPositionChange`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ec5eb923dacc2bbfec791ae2c080a87a4374ea73/src/manager/DragCoordinator.mjs#L1168) already excludes geometry produced by its parking/embodiment/settlement operations from fresh native gestures. Preserve that distinction when lifting quiescence. [D#18224's transaction protocol](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/18224#discussioncomment-18292268) owns transaction/effect correlation and generation-fenced receipts.

## Placement producer boundary and current implementation

The placement participant is implemented in PR #18377 on `codex/18313-observed-popup-placement`. PR #18370 is merged at `dev@9fd3250bd0`; the placement branch is rebased onto that merge without changing its source tree. The real Chrome/Neural Link journey now passes: a free popup burst appends once; moving the main frame rebases hints without changing history; undo and redo carry native-effect identity through the geometry publisher and remain stable past quiescence; a later independent move appends; topology capture retains the relative hints; popup reload preserves hints and history. Unit controls cover two-popup rebasing, headless hints, refusal/clamping and retired-generation completion.

One input boundary must stay visible across the Epic: persisted `placementHints` keys must refer to existing `workspaces`. Demo B registers its semantic popup documents; Workstation's ordinary tear-out still creates a bare vessel target with `document: null` until the first accepted dock into it. The cold slots delivered by #18315 do have documents before materialization. I verified the current source and reconciled it with Euclid's `a91c30fa75` source check.

This leaf records document-bearing Group slots and exposes `getPlacementHints()` for the host's topology capture callback. It does not manufacture another document owner for ordinary bare vessels. The ordinary-birth/all-origin integration remains explicit with #18314 and the final production journey in #18316; this implementation must not be cited as having delivered that remaining producer path. No slot without a semantic document can produce an invalid persisted hint.

The native quiet-period proof caught a real feedback gap: an explicit tagged publication left the movement poll's old baseline behind, allowing an untagged echo. The publisher now acknowledges the tagged position; the real-browser quiet-period control and the unit tagged→poll→independent-move control both pass.
